2554841e702c9465.description: About Namaa Partners Namaa Partners is a management consulting firm based in Oklahoma City. The firm advises corporate groups, family enterprises, and their boards on strategy, governance, and operating performance. The Role of Executive Support Assistant Namaa Partners is seeking an Executive Support Assistant to provide remote, full-time support in Saudi Arabia. This role is essential for managing local arrangements, meetings, and documents for the firm's principals, who travel to Riyadh several times per quarter to meet with boards and family owners. The position is remote, allowing work from anywhere in Saudi Arabia, including cities such as Jeddah, Makkah, and Riyadh. Due to the time difference with Oklahoma City, some calls will occur in the late afternoon. Key Responsibilities Schedule meetings with client boards, executives, and family offices across various time zones. Arrange travel, accommodation, visas, and meeting rooms for principals visiting Saudi Arabia. Prepare meeting packs and take notes during client meetings. Manage incoming correspondence and follow up on open actions. Maintain current contact lists, files, and the engagement calendar. Qualifications and Experience A bachelor's degree in business administration or a related field. 0-1 years of experience as an executive, administrative, or personal assistant, including internships. Proficiency in Microsoft 365, including Outlook calendars and PowerPoint. Preferred Attributes Experience supporting senior executives or a board. Experience arranging business travel within the Gulf region. Compensation This position offers a monthly salary paid in Saudi riyals.

25a1a642d7f0bbea.description: About BAE Systems Saudi Arabia BAE Systems operates as the UK Government’s nominated Prime Contractor under Government-to-Government agreements, providing equipment, support, and training to Saudi Arabia. The company is responsible for the maintenance of Royal Saudi Air Force (RSAF) aircraft and for training RSAF and Royal Saudi Naval Force personnel in the safe use of aircraft, equipment, and weapons. BAE Systems Saudi Arabia is dedicated to supporting the Saudi Arabian National Agenda, including Saudisation and the development of Saudi National capabilities through partnerships and industrialisation. The Role of Component Paint Supervisor BAE Systems Saudi Arabia is seeking a Component Paint Supervisor for a full-time position in Taif. This role involves deputising for a senior company employee within the Typhoon Maintenance Organisation, with responsibility for all aspects of the Component Paint Shop. The supervisor will ensure compliance, drive continuous improvement, and manage line management responsibilities, including providing functional direction, guidance, welfare, and health & safety oversight. The position requires 2-5 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Review maintenance practices and identify opportunities for improvement within the organisation. Identify and report any malpractice affecting airworthiness or safety of components or personnel to the Senior Maintenance Manager. Ensure adequate manpower and facilities are available to meet duties and contractual obligations. Monitor personnel standards to address negative trends, non-conformities, or motivational deficiencies. Manage and be accountable for the development reports of all direct and indirect reports within the area of responsibility. Foster a professional working environment that adheres to the company’s "Code of Conduct." Provide training, consolidation, and counterpart development for RSAF and BAE Systems personnel. Ensure timely completion of tasks to support Forward Maintenance and SMU activities. Maintain operational readiness of shop equipment, including scheduling calibrations and ensuring availability of correct tooling and approved data. Verify that all personnel undertaking maintenance are authorised. Report and monitor equipment and infrastructure damage or deficiencies using appropriate media. Conduct anti-FOD surveillance and report potential hazards through regular shop and component oversight checks. Ensure all maintenance tasks meet the highest quality standards, including accurate recording on the airworthiness tool (ESS). Perform oversight checks to maintain high standards of shop husbandry. Assist in updating the TTP131 spreadsheet for forecasted planning and highlight deficiencies or delivery issues with consumables and PPE. Ensure daily shop status is updated promptly for customer and company reporting. Ensure individual breathing air quality tests/qualifications are completed and documented. Conduct individual breathing air quality checks/mask checks and annual COSSH medicals in accordance with company procedures. Maintain and archive individual records in compliance with Company HSE or local instructions. Qualifications and Experience Essential: A recognised qualification to NVQ3/ONC/OND/BTEC level in a relevant technical discipline, a technical apprenticeship, or an equivalent technical qualification acceptable to M&CA. Extensive post-qualification practical maintenance experience within an operational flying aircraft environment, supported by formal recorded workplace training, OR 3 years on the same aircraft type. Demonstrated leadership skills and proven ability to supervise engineering personnel at all levels. Relevant type training (‘Q’ Course) and equipment-specific training, if required. Ability to obtain and maintain Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE) membership at the appropriate level prior to commencing employment in KSA. Desirable: Working knowledge of EASA/M&CA Part 145. Thorough understanding of company processes and procedures. Broad aerospace and defence industry knowledge. Proven supervisory experience within the defined area. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Taif, Saudi Arabia, within the Typhoon Maintenance Organisation. The role involves working within a structured environment that prioritises compliance, continuous improvement, and adherence to health and safety standards.

25d0511c59a8f3c0.job_title: B B Sales & Partnerships Executive Saudi Nationality
25d0511c59a8f3c0.description: About SleekFlow SleekFlow is a company focused on redefining B2B relationships by converting conversations into data-backed growth opportunities. The core of its platform is AgentFlow, an AI GTM workforce designed for continuous learning and improvement. SleekFlow unifies various communication channels, including WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, SMS, Website Live Chat, Email, and Call, into a comprehensive AI operating system. The platform is trusted by over 2,000 enterprises across more than 70 countries. The Role of Growth Partnerships Executive SleekFlow is seeking a Growth Partnerships Executive, also referred to as a Sales Development Representative (SDR) Contractor, to join the team in Saudi Arabia. This is a contract position designed as a hybrid role, combining the lead generation and prospecting functions of an SDR with responsibilities for developing and activating referral partnerships within the EMEA market. This role is suitable for individuals with SDR experience who are looking to expand their skills in partnerships and business development. Key Responsibilities Identify prospective clients and engage them through various outbound channels such as calls, emails, and LinkedIn to build a sales pipeline for the Account Executive team. Research and identify potential referral partners that align with SleekFlow’s growth strategy to establish mutually beneficial business partnerships. Support the onboarding and enablement of referral partners to ensure consistent deal referrals. Collaborate with internal teams on go-to-market (GTM) initiatives, co-marketing campaigns, and pipeline acceleration efforts. Track activity and pipeline progress using CRM tools such as HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Lusha, SalesQL, and ******* Monitor industry trends and competitor activities to identify new partnership opportunities. Execute outbound prospecting, qualify leads, and engage prospects aligned with the Ideal Customer Profile to fill the sales pipeline. Identify, onboard, and nurture channel partners, including digital agencies, CRM consultants, and technology providers, who can refer new business. Work closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to align GTM activities and campaigns. Qualifications and Requirements 0–2 years of experience in sales, business development, partnerships, growth, or a related field. Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply. Proven experience as an SDR or in outbound lead generation. Familiarity with outbound sales processes, including cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn prospecting, and follow-up sequences. Familiarity with email cadences and sales engagement workflows. Comfortable working with modern sales technology tools such as HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Lusha, SalesQL, and ******* Strong communication and relationship-building skills. Proficiency in both written and verbal English and Arabic communication. Self-starter mindset, demonstrating structured, proactive, and growth-oriented qualities. Strong understanding of the local business environment in Saudi Arabia. Preferred Qualifications Experience with B2B SaaS or digital platforms. Exposure to affiliate, reseller, or channel partnership models. Regional or multi-market experience within EMEA. Application Process Further details regarding the application process and salary will be provided upon inquiry.

2518c5d2c10530c3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الفارس العربي للتجارة عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في مدينة بريدة، بمنطقة القصيم. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة العمليات المالية للشركة، بما في ذلك إعداد المستندات المحاسبية، ومتابعة الإيرادات، وتدقيق الحسابات المصرفية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المحاسبة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف، ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بناءً على الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات، وتدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في هذا المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المحاسبة. فهم قوي للمبادئ والمعايير المحاسبية. القدرة على إعداد وتحليل التقارير المالية. مهارات ممتازة في تنظيم وتوثيق المستندات المالية. المهارات والكفاءات الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في جميع المهام المحاسبية. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. مهارات تواصل فعالة كتابة وشفهياً. القدرة على التكيف مع التطورات في مجال المحاسبة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة الفارس العربي للتجارة في بريدة، القصيم. ستتاح للمحاسب فرصة للمساهمة في تعزيز الكفاءة المالية للشركة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عملنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين.

255f22f0fa62c67e.description: About the Role Dafater is seeking a Business Analyst Specialist ERP to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting ERP implementation projects by collaborating with clients and internal teams. The specialist will gather requirements, analyze business processes, and document specifications for ERP solutions. Role Context Working alongside senior analysts and the Project Manager, this position connects business stakeholders with functional and technical teams. The role spans discovery, solution design, testing, and go-live phases, ensuring that requirements remain clear, traceable, and validated throughout project delivery. Key Responsibilities Participate in and facilitate discovery workshops and stakeholder interviews to capture business objectives, operational challenges, and requirements. Document current (as-is) processes and support the design of improved (to-be) processes, including workflows, business rules, and roles. Perform fit-gap analysis against ERP capabilities and propose configuration or process changes for review. Prepare business requirements, functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Maintain requirements traceability from business needs through implementation and testing. Work with functional consultants, developers, and integration teams to clarify requirements and validate proposed solutions. Capture business requirements for reports, data migration, integrations, and access permissions. Prepare user acceptance testing (UAT) scenarios, support business users during testing, and log and follow up on defects. Contribute to training materials, process documentation, and go-live readiness activities. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated ability to gather and document business requirements for ERP solutions. Experience in analyzing business processes and performing fit-gap analysis. Working at Dafater Joining Dafater provides an opportunity to help organizations translate business challenges into effective ERP solutions. The role involves working with a collaborative team that values innovation and practical problem-solving. Employees can develop their expertise through varied client challenges and opportunities for professional growth.

250927fb9914a2bd.description: About the Graduate Programme in Project & Programme Management Mace Group is offering a two-year Graduate Programme in Project & Programme Management, commencing in early September 2027. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with potential for project assignments within a 40km radius of Riyadh. The programme is designed for individuals with 0-1 years of experience, providing hands-on involvement in live projects from day one. Role Overview and Responsibilities As a Graduate in Project & Programme Management, you will contribute to various projects across the built environment, working with multidisciplinary teams. Your responsibilities may include supporting project delivery, planning, design coordination, cost and commercial management, sustainability initiatives, risk assessment, data analysis, or client engagement. The programme also includes structured learning, professional development, and mentorship, alongside networking opportunities through community initiatives and industry events. Work Environment and Project Scope You will be employed at Mace's Riyadh office or at client locations. Working locations may vary based on project assignments within the Kingdom. While most projects are in Riyadh, some may be located approximately 40km outside the city, requiring daily commuting. Flexibility and an adaptable approach to travel are essential. Mace Consult reimburses eligible business travel expenses, including mileage, public transport, and accommodation where necessary. For sites difficult to reach by public transport, a valid driving license or access to a vehicle is required. Projects span various sectors, including Cities & Places, Government & Communities, Health, Life Sciences & Technology, Mobility (Rail and Highways), and Resilience (nuclear, energy, and utilities). Qualifications and Requirements Completion of, or due to complete by September 2027, a bachelor’s degree or higher in one of the following subjects: Architecture or Architectural Design, BIM, Building Surveying, CIAT-accredited Architectural Technology, Civil or Structural Engineering, Construction Management, Design Management, Digital Construction, Engineering, Project Management, Quantity Surveying, or any other built environment-related subject. No more than one year of work experience. GPA score of or above. Mastery of the English language (verbal and written). Data analysis and interpretation skills. Saudi Arabian nationality. Desired Attributes Candidates should demonstrate curiosity, a growth mindset, confidence, resilience, commitment, reliability, and drive. Alignment with Mace's values of Safety first, Client focus, Create opportunity, and Integrity is expected. Desired behaviours include being curious, collaborative, a contributor, and a champion of inclusion. Key competencies include building effective teams, embracing change, solving problems, and building trusted relationships. Application Process Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and the vacancy may close early if a sufficient number of applications are received. The anticipated closing date for applications is Sunday, February 28th, 2027. Outcomes for both successful and unsuccessful candidates are expected to be communicated by early April 2027. Due to the volume of applications, individual feedback cannot be provided at this initial stage.

253155488686be90.job_title: QNB Assistant Vice President Credit Risk (Saudization)
253155488686be90.description: About The Arab Energy Fund The Arab Energy Fund is seeking a Senior Credit Risk Analyst to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience and focuses on supporting the independent review and management of corporate banking credit proposals and portfolio risks. Role Overview The Senior Credit Risk Analyst will play a key role in assessing the creditworthiness of borrowers and projects within the Corporate Banking portfolio. This involves detailed financial analysis, preparing risk reviews, and ensuring compliance with internal credit policies and governance frameworks. The role supports various aspects of credit risk management, from initial transaction review to ongoing portfolio monitoring and reporting. Key Responsibilities Assist in the independent review of Corporate Banking proposals, including new transactions, facility renewals, annual reviews, amendments, and waivers. Analyze historical and projected financial statements, cash flows, and relevant credit information to assess financial position and debt-servicing capacity. Prepare concise risk reviews and credit recommendations, covering internal ratings, key risks and mitigants, and the appropriateness of facility structures, security, covenants, and other terms. Engage with Corporate Banking teams to clarify proposal-related queries and address information gaps. Support Credit Committee governance, including the preparation of meeting minutes. Ensure internal credit ratings are accurately assessed according to approved models and reflect the transaction’s credit profile. Maintain credit logs and ensure relevant shared folders are complete, accurate, and up to date. Support portfolio management by monitoring and reporting credit exposures and limits against approved policies and risk appetite, escalating breaches as required. Prepare the monthly Credit Risk Dashboard and support periodic and ad hoc risk reporting. Participate in the computation and management of Expected Credit Loss, including the review of provisions with Finance. Promote a sound credit risk culture and effective stakeholder engagement across the Risk Division and with key functions such as Corporate Banking, Finance, Operations, and IT. Required Knowledge and Experience Strong understanding of Corporate Credit Risk principles. Experience within the Banking and Energy sectors. Knowledge of Project Finance. Working knowledge of financial modeling and analysis. Education and Certification Requirements Bachelor’s degree in a business or a quantitative/analytical field. Additional professional qualifications (*, CFA, FRM, PRM, or Credit Risk certifications) are considered an asset. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, offering an opportunity to contribute to the financial stability and risk management framework of The Arab Energy Fund.

256f4f019590eab4.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مدي نوبا الطبي عن موظف استقبال للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى توفير تجربة استقبال احترافية للزوار والعملاء، وإدارة المكالمات الهاتفية، وتنظيم السجلات لضمان سير العمل بسلاسة وفعالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال الزوار والعملاء والترحيب بهم، وتحديد متطلباتهم، وتقديم المعلومات اللازمة لهم. إبلاغ المرجع المعني بوصول المراجعين والعملاء وتوجيههم إليه. استقبال المكالمات الهاتفية والرد على الاستفسارات أو تحويلها إلى القسم المختص. إجراء الاتصالات الداخلية للحصول على المعلومات المطلوبة. ترتيب وتنسيق مواعيد المقابلات. تسجيل أسماء المراجعين والعملاء في السجلات المخصصة لذلك. الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات التنظيمية المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الاستقبال أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع الزوار والعملاء بأسلوب مهني وودي. مهارات تواصل ممتازة شفهياً وكتابياً. القدرة على تنظيم المهام وتحديد الأولويات بفعالية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل موظف الاستقبال ضمن بيئة مهنية تهدف إلى تقديم أفضل خدمة للعملاء والزوار. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لشغل هذه الوظيفة.

25cd42a20f2a86a7.description: About the Role Sika is seeking a Target Market Manager Refurbishment to join their team in Al Khobar, Eastern region. This full-time position is responsible for leading all strategic and business development activities for the Refurbishment Target Market within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The role requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Lead and coordinate with internal departments to implement strategic actions and achieve profitability targets. Ensure alignment with global strategy by coordinating with the Corporate Target Market Manager. Implement the Product Line Simplification (PLS) strategy and focus on strategic products/systems to develop sales across territories. Analyze market potential, identify key targets, and translate plans into actionable steps. Build and maintain relationships with existing and potential customers, providing strong support for Target Market development. Manage relationships with large applicators, address technical requirements, and collaborate with regional managers to develop new applicators. Define and implement pricing strategies based on market intelligence and competition to gain market share and achieve sales targets. Initiate and implement cross-selling opportunities in coordination with Vertical Market Managers and the sales team. Promote value selling and ensure the application of Target Market know-how through continuous training programs. Identify and develop products to meet customer needs, coordinating PLS with relevant departments and ensuring portfolio standardization. Prepare monthly and quarterly reports, along with business data for budget and 3-year plans. Monitor competitor activities, establish proactive measures, and identify potential acquisitions. Mitigate challenges and initiate corrective actions as necessary. Technical Support and Market Strategy Provide technical support to sales, including organizing seminars and workshops to promote products and solutions. Act as a technical consultant and trouble-shooter for customers, handling and following up on technical complaints. Liaise with sales, marketing, and technical service teams to enhance business opportunities and solve technical problems. Provide technical recommendations for strategy development based on product performance analysis against competitors. Follow up on sales leads and conduct customer visits in alignment with the regional sales team. 25debeb7601f77ee.job_title: Host (Pre Opening) DoubleTree by Hilton Olaya North
25debeb7601f77ee.description: About the Role Accor is seeking a Hostess to provide a warm, professional, and personalized welcome to all guests, ensuring an exceptional first impression and seamless dining experience. This full-time role involves managing restaurant reservations, coordinating guest seating, maintaining guest relationships, and proactively generating dining reservations to support F&B revenue objectives. The Hostess acts as an ambassador for the hotel, promoting its dining concepts and encouraging positive online feedback. Key Responsibilities Warmly and professionally welcome all guests, ensuring immediate acknowledgment upon arrival. Manage restaurant reservations, including inquiries, confirmations, modifications, and cancellations, ensuring accuracy. Maintain and update the restaurant reservation database with guest contact details, preferences, and booking history. Proactively contact guests to promote restaurant experiences, special dining events, and F&B promotions. Conduct outbound calls to generate additional restaurant bookings and increase covers. Escort guests to their tables, ensuring comfort and communicating special requirements to the service team. Recognize VIPs, repeat guests, and special occasions to provide personalized attention. Actively encourage satisfied guests to share dining experiences on approved online review platforms. Maintain comprehensive knowledge of hotel facilities, F&B outlets, menus, promotions, and operating hours. Coordinate table allocations with the Outlet Supervisor and monitor restaurant occupancy and table availability. Answer incoming telephone calls within three rings, adhering to hotel etiquette. Ensure the hostess station, menus, and promotional materials are clean, organized, and updated. Comply with all hotel policies and procedures, including those related to Fire, Hygiene, Health, and Safety. Performance Expectations Performance will be evaluated based on guest welcoming and first impressions, reservation accuracy and booking conversion, proactive outbound calls and reservations generated, guest recognition and relationship management, and guest feedback and online review engagement. Adherence to hotel grooming and service standards is also a key expectation. Qualifications and Experience Experience: Minimum of 2 years of experience as a Hostess or in a guest-facing role within a 5-star hotel, luxury restaurant, or high-end hospitality environment. Education: Diploma or degree in Hospitality Management, Hotel Management, or a related field. Language: Fluent in English. Appearance: Well-groomed and presentable, maintaining the high standards of a luxury hotel. Availability: Flexible to work shifts, weekends, and public holidays. Required Skills Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a warm, welcoming, and professional attitude. Strong customer service skills with the ability to anticipate guests' needs and exceed expectations. Excellent organizational skills to manage reservations, seating arrangements, and guest flow efficiently. Ability to handle guest inquiries, special requests, and complaints with professionalism and discretion. Strong attention to detail and the ability to remain calm and composed in a fast-paced environment. A positive attitude, team spirit, and passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences. Knowledge of luxury hospitality etiquette, hotel standards, and international service standards. Work Environment The Hostess will work in a dynamic hotel environment, requiring adaptability to operational changes and business requirements. This role may involve rotation between F&B outlets based on operational needs and appropriate training, and requires attendance at departmental meetings, briefings, and training sessions as required.

25e4cd9b7dcf605b.description: About the Opportunity SNC-Lavalin Fayez Engineering is seeking a highly experienced Commissioning Authority – Electrical Systems to lead critical commissioning, testing, energization, and operational readiness activities. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and supports a prestigious mega infrastructure and landscape development project. The project encompasses major utility networks, substations, power distribution systems, street and landscape lighting, intelligent transportation systems, smart city infrastructure, pumping stations, and associated electrical assets. Role Overview The Commissioning Authority will serve as the client's independent representative, ensuring that all electrical systems are planned, tested, commissioned, and handed over in accordance with project requirements, operational objectives, and international best practices. Working within the PMCM team, this role provides leadership throughout the commissioning lifecycle, focusing on safe energization, performance validation, and seamless integration of electrical systems while supporting the project's quality, sustainability, and operational excellence goals. Key Responsibilities Lead and oversee all commissioning activities for electrical infrastructure systems across the mega project. Develop and implement commissioning plans, procedures, schedules, and governance frameworks for electrical assets and systems. Review design documentation to ensure commissioning requirements, operational functionality, maintainability, and system performance objectives are incorporated. Manage pre-commissioning, testing, energization, integrated systems testing, commissioning, and final handover activities. Review and approve contractor commissioning plans, method statements, test procedures, inspection plans, and energization strategies. Witness and verify testing and commissioning activities for substations, MV/LV distribution systems, lighting, backup power, control systems, and smart infrastructure assets. Lead integrated testing activities involving electrical, mechanical, controls, ICT, SCADA, and smart city systems. Identify commissioning risks, technical challenges, and operational constraints, and implement mitigation and resolution strategies. Coordinate with contractors, consultants, utility providers, client representatives, operators, and regulatory authorities throughout the commissioning process. Monitor commissioning performance, progress, and readiness activities, providing executive-level reporting and recommendations. Ensure compliance with project specifications, utility requirements, safety regulations, electrical standards, and operational acceptance criteria. Support asset readiness programs including training, O&M documentation reviews, operational procedures, and handover requirements. Validate system performance against design intent, reliability requirements, and operational objectives prior to project acceptance. Promote best practices, lessons learned, and continuous improvement throughout the commissioning and transition-to-operations lifecycle. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. A Master's degree is advantageous. Minimum of 15+ years of experience in electrical commissioning, testing, energization, and operational readiness for major infrastructure or utility projects. Proven experience serving as a Commissioning Authority, Commissioning Manager, Electrical Commissioning Lead, or equivalent senior role on large-scale developments. Extensive expertise in substations, MV/LV power distribution systems, lighting systems, control systems, utility infrastructure, backup power systems, and smart city electrical networks. 25f72caafd7cd3a3.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مركز الصحة الفريدة للعلاج الطبيعي عن أخصائي علاج وظيفي للانضمام إلى فريقه في منطقة القصيم، وتحديداً في مدينتي راس تنورة والرس. يركز هذا الدور على مساعدة المرضى في تحسين قدراتهم على أداء مهام الحياة اليومية والعمل، بالإضافة إلى تعليمهم كيفية استخدام المعدات التكيفية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى أخصائي العلاج الوظيفي مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لدعم المرضى في استعادة وظائفهم وتحسين جودة حياتهم. تشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: مساعدة المرضى في تحسين قدرتهم على أداء مهام الحياة اليومية والعمل. تدريب المرضى على أداء الأنشطة المتعلقة بالاحتياجات اليومية مثل ارتداء الملابس، الطهي، وتناول الطعام. استخدام التمارين البدنية لزيادة القوة البدنية واستعادة البراعة الجسدية والتغلب على مشاكل التنسيق الحركي. تعليم ذوي الإعاقات الدائمة كيفية استخدام معدات التكيف، بما في ذلك الكراسي المتحركة والجبائر، والأدوات الخاصة المساعدة في تناول الطعام وارتداء الملابس. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في مجال العلاج الوظيفي. المؤهلات والخبرة يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحين يمتلكون الخلفية التعليمية والخبرة العملية المناسبة لتقديم رعاية علاجية فعالة. تشمل المتطلبات الأساسية ما يلي: خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال العلاج الوظيفي. القدرة على تطبيق أساليب العلاج الوظيفي لمساعدة المرضى في استعادة وظائفهم اليومية. الالتزام بتطوير الممارسات المهنية ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في المجال. بيئة العمل سيعمل أخصائي العلاج الوظيفي ضمن فريق مركز الصحة الفريدة للعلاج الطبيعي في بيئة داعمة تهدف إلى تقديم أفضل رعاية للمرضى. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بتقديم خدمات علاجية عالية الجودة. الموقع يتوفر هذا الدور في منطقة القصيم، وتحديداً في مدينتي راس تنورة والرس. يُتوقع من المرشحين القدرة على العمل في هذه المواقع. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق مركز الصحة الفريدة للعلاج الطبيعي كأخصائي علاج وظيفي، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة التفاصيل المتعلقة بالراتب والخطوات التالية.

Proficiency in Esri ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise/Online, Esri Geo-BIM, FME, and SQL/spatial databases. Knowledge of Python and Power BI is advantageous. Ability to interpret survey, CAD, BIM, planning, and engineering information and integrate it into GIS structures. Understanding of asset and location registers, attribute schemas, and coding systems. Personal Attributes High attention to detail and strong focus on accuracy and traceability. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Well-organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. Proactive approach with the ability to identify risks and propose practical solutions early. Strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to work effectively under pressure in a multicultural project environment. High level of integrity, accountability, and professional judgment. Work Environment and Location This role requires availability to be based on site in Riyadh, in line with the project deployment plan, and to mobilize within short timeframes. The position is full-time.

25a77e713be96532.description: About Unifonic Unifonic is an AI-native customer experience platform designed for emerging markets, recognized as a Great Place to Work®. With over 25 years of conversational AI research and development, Unifonic serves more than 5,000 enterprises across MENA. The company is pioneering sovereign, agentic AI through its Agentic Studio platform, valuing creativity, collaboration, and innovation from its employees. The Sales Team at Unifonic The Sales team at Unifonic focuses on driving revenue while acting as trusted consultants to customers. This team includes experts in account management, business development, and customer service, working closely with other departments to ensure products and services meet customer needs. The team seeks individuals with a track record of sales success, who enjoy building relationships and are passionate about assisting others. Strategic Account Manager Role Overview As a Strategic Account Manager based in Riyadh, Riyadh Province, you will manage and expand a portfolio of high-value enterprise accounts within regulated industries such as government, financial services, telecommunications, and large enterprises. This full-time role involves building and maintaining trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, driving customer retention and revenue growth, and managing renewals and expansion opportunities to ensure long-term customer success. You will develop strategic account plans, identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities, lead executive-level account governance, and proactively manage customer risks and escalations. Close coordination with internal sales, technical, delivery, customer success, and support teams is essential to meet customer needs and achieve measurable business outcomes. The role requires 5-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Own and manage a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts. Achieve and exceed annual recurring revenue (ARR), expansion, upsell, and retention targets. Develop and execute account plans for key customers. Identify and drive cross-sell and upsell opportunities across the product portfolio. Lead contract renewals and commercial negotiations. Build trusted relationships with C-level, business, and technical stakeholders. Serve as the primary point of contact for strategic customers. Conduct executive business reviews and governance meetings. Ensure customer objectives align with company capabilities and roadmap. Monitor customer health, adoption, satisfaction, and business outcomes. Manage escalations and coordinate resolution across internal teams. Improve retention and reduce churn risk through proactive engagement. Drive successful onboarding and service expansion initiatives. Prepare quarterly account reviews, forecasts, and business plans. Maintain accurate account data, opportunity tracking, and forecasting within CRM. Coordinate with Sales, Product, Customer Success, Delivery, Finance, and Legal teams. Ensure compliance with contractual obligations and internal processes. Maintain a strong understanding of regulated sectors and industry trends in Saudi Arabia. Provide customer feedback to Product and Leadership teams. Represent the company in strategic customer engagements and industry events. Required Character Traits Analytical thinking and problem-solving: Ability to approach problems clearly, utilize data, and identify solutions. Ownership and accountability: Takes responsibility and ensures projects are completed. Communication: Clearly explains ideas and actively listens to others across teams. Collaboration: Works effectively with others and supports team objectives. Adaptability and learning: Adjusts to change and continuously acquires new skills or tools. Mentorship and knowledge sharing: Supports the growth of others and shares expertise. Resilience: Maintains composure under pressure and addresses setbacks constructively. Quality and attention to detail: Executes work carefully and strives for continuous improvement. Advocacy and innovation: Promotes best practices, efficiency, and new ideas.

252534324e1229d8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صناع المراتب للصناعة عن مدير فرع للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف على كافة العمليات الإدارية والتشغيلية للفرع، وضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة بما يتوافق مع استراتيجيات الشركة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2-5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في وضع وإعداد أهداف الفرع بما يتماشى مع التوجهات والاستراتيجيات العامة للشركة. إدارة وتخطيط وتنظيم أعمال الفرع ووحداته الإدارية لضمان التوافق مع الخطط التشغيلية والبرامج التنفيذية المعتمدة. متابعة كافة العمليات الإدارية المتعلقة بالفرع، وضمان توفر الموارد التقنية والبشرية اللازمة لسير العمليات اليومية. تطوير الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التفصيلية للفرع ومتابعة تنفيذها لضمان أفضل المخرجات وتحقيق أعلى مستويات الكفاءة والإنتاجية. الإشراف العام على سير العمليات والإجراءات في الفرع، وضمان الالتزام بكافة الأنظمة واللوائح والسياسات المعتمدة. متابعة أداء موظفي الفرع والإشراف على برامج الموارد البشرية الهادفة إلى تقييمهم وتطويرهم وتحفيزهم. بناء علاقات عمل فعالة مع الشركاء الخارجيين وتنسيق المشروعات والجهود المشتركة. ضمان وجود قنوات تواصل داخلية فعالة تحقق مستوى عالياً من التكامل بين إدارات الفرع. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال إدارة الفروع أو ما يعادلها. فهم عميق لعمليات التخطيط والإدارة والتنظيم. القدرة على تطوير الخطط التشغيلية ومتابعة تنفيذها. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية وإشرافية ممتازة. قدرة عالية على اتخاذ القرار وحل المشكلات. مهارات تواصل قوية وفعالة، كتابية وشفوية. القدرة على بناء وإدارة العلاقات مع الأطراف الداخلية والخارجية. القدرة على تحفيز وتطوير فرق العمل. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل مدير الفرع ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب التفاعل المستمر مع فرق العمل الداخلية والشركاء الخارجيين. تقديم الطلبات لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

25527def4f1493b4.description: About the Role Jotun Saudi Arabia is seeking a Senior Sales Executive - Projects to join their team in Medina. This full-time role involves supporting the Area Sales Manager in driving business-to-business sales of Jotun Decorative products to new, existing, and targeted project customers. The position requires 2-5 years of experience and focuses on utilizing sales tools, building customer relationships, identifying business opportunities, and executing sales plans to achieve targets for sales, gross margin, Day Sales Outstanding (DSO), and market share, while ensuring sustainable profitability. Gather market insights and competitive intelligence, and build strong customer relationships to achieve sales targets and support sustainable business growth. Conduct systematic ground mapping and regular area audits of ongoing and upcoming construction and infrastructure projects to identify decorative painting opportunities ahead of the tender/specification stage and assess market potential. Build, maintain, and continuously update a qualified sales pipeline in CRM, aligned with sales top-line (STP) and budget targets, ensuring accurate opportunity tracking, stage management, and sales forecasting. Monitor awarded projects throughout execution to maintain Jotun's position, defend the agreed project scope against competitor penetration, and ensure project requirements are met. Proactively manage assigned accounts through diligent follow-up, reconciliation, and documentation to ensure adherence to credit terms and achievement of DSO targets. Collaborate with internal departments to ensure timely delivery and excellent customer service. Read and interpret project technical documents to provide accurate product recommendations, quotations, and compliance with project specifications. Undertake and regularly update area audits to identify market potential within the designated geographical area in collaboration with the Supervisor. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will possess a strong commercial acumen, demonstrating the ability to identify and capitalize on business opportunities to positively impact growth and profitability. Building and leveraging a network of contacts and relationships to achieve objectives is essential. A methodical and systematic approach to planning, prioritizing, and resource allocation is required. Required Personal Qualities Ability to identify and seize commercial opportunities, with a positive impact on business growth and profitability. Proficiency in building and utilizing a network of contacts and relationships to achieve objectives. A methodical and systematic approach to planning, defining clear priorities, and allocating resources effectively. Strong collaborative skills, including sharing knowledge, experience, and information, and supporting team goals. Focus on bottom-line results, identifying potential risks, and monitoring the financial impact of activities. Adherence to company rules and procedures, executing plans with commitment, and achieving high-quality results. What Jotun Offers Competitive compensation and benefits package. Continuous learning opportunities and training activities through on-the-job training and the in-house Jotun Academy. Career development opportunities across multiple disciplines and geographies. 25e95c9d29f0dd2b.description: About the Role Halwani Brothers is seeking a Category Manager to take full ownership of a category's performance. This full-time role, based in Jeddah or Makkah, Makkah region, involves overseeing all aspects of marketing, sales growth, and profitability. The Category Manager will develop and execute strategies to enhance category visibility, consumer engagement, and revenue generation. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement category strategies to drive sales, market share, and profitability. Conduct in-depth market analysis to identify trends, consumer behavior, and competitive opportunities. Define category pricing, promotions, and distribution strategies to maximize revenue. Monitor category performance, making proactive adjustments to improve growth and profitability. Conduct monthly market visits, retail audit analysis, and prepare category overviews with action plans. Plan and execute marketing initiatives to strengthen category positioning and increase brand awareness. Develop and launch category-specific advertising, promotional, and digital marketing campaigns. Create and oversee marketing materials, ensuring consistency in messaging and brand representation. Evaluate campaign effectiveness using key performance metrics and optimize strategies accordingly. Manage the category’s social media presence, ensuring engaging and consumer-relevant content. Develop and execute digital campaigns that align with category objectives and drive consumer conversion. Oversee influencer marketing, paid media, and content strategy for category growth. Track digital performance metrics, adjusting strategies for better engagement and sales impact. Drive product innovation within the category, identifying opportunities for new SKUs and enhancements. Manage packaging development and ensure alignment with category positioning and profitability goals. Oversee consumer testing, refining products based on feedback and market insights. Optimize product lifecycle management, including launches, reformulations, and discontinuations. Independently handle agency partnerships for creative, media, and digital marketing. Negotiate and oversee supplier relationships for packaging, promotional materials, and activations. Ensure timely and high-quality execution of all category marketing initiatives. Monitor agency and supplier performance, ensuring cost efficiency and brand consistency. Manage category budgets, ensuring efficient allocation of resources to maximize ROI. Track and report sales, market share, and profitability metrics for category evaluation. Use data analytics and market research to drive informed category decisions. Prepare regular business reviews with insights and action plans for category growth. Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in category management. Proven ability to independently drive category initiatives and manage product launches. Experience overseeing social media and digital campaigns. Demonstrated ability to handle agency and supplier relationships effectively. Application Process Candidates who meet the above qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

25736d1b05e29add.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة مصادر الانشاء للمقاولات عن مشرف صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في القنفذة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان تطبيق معايير السلامة والصحة المهنية في المنشآت، والتحقيق في الحوادث، وإعداد الإجراءات والتقارير اللازمة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى مشرف الصحة والسلامة المهنية مسؤولية متابعة وتطبيق اللوائح والتعليمات المتعلقة بالسلامة، بالإضافة إلى قياس العوامل البيئية والتحقيق في الحوادث. تشمل المهام الأساسية ما يلي: إجراء عمليات التفتيش الدورية والطارئة في مواقع العمل لضمان الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والصحة المهنية، وتوثيق النتائج ومقارنتها بالمعايير المعتمدة. تجهيز واستخدام أجهزة قياس العوامل البيئية مثل درجة الحرارة والرطوبة والضجيج والاهتزاز، وتوثيق النتائج ومتابعة معالجة الأخطار مع الجهات المختصة. تحضير مستلزمات التحقيق في الحوادث والإصابات، وإجراء التحقيقات اللازمة، وتوثيق النتائج بشكل دقيق. إعداد تعليمات وإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية، بما في ذلك تعليمات العمل الآمن والإخلاء، وتوعية العاملين بها. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها لضمان المتابعة والرجوع إليها عند الحاجة. المؤهلات والخبرة لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح الخبرات والمؤهلات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. القدرة على متابعة وتطبيق القوانين واللوائح التنظيمية المتعلقة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية. مهارات جيدة في قياس العوامل البيئية والتحقيق في الحوادث والإصابات. بيئة العمل يعمل مشرف الصحة والسلامة المهنية بدوام كامل في مواقع مؤسسة مصادر الانشاء للمقاولات بمدينة القنفذة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى الحفاظ على بيئة عمل آمنة وصحية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

25d638e5b3f45bb4.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة نبع الطاقة للمقاولات عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، تقدير المواد، والإشراف على التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال ومعالجتها. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية للمشاريع المنزلية، الصناعية، والتجارية، وفهم مكوناتها بدقة. تقدير الكميات المطلوبة من المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية، وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات، مع التأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية. متابعة جميع مراحل تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية، والإشراف على تشغيل الدارات الكهربائية، وإجراء الفحوصات اللازمة مثل فحوصات العازلية، الاستمرارية، والتأريض. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، بالإضافة إلى متابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية لضمان استمرارية الأداء. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية في جميع مراحل العمل لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الكهربائية بكفاءة. معرفة قوية بأنواع المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية ومواصفاتها. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية وتحديد الحلول المناسبة. الإلمام بإجراءات ومعايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الكهرباء في بيئة مقاولات ديناميكية في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق متخصص يركز على تنفيذ وصيانة التمديدات الكهربائية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

25312af5fda06b12.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن الجمعية الخيرية لرعاية الأيتام بالمنطقة الشرقية (بناء) عن حاجتها لـ مدير إشراف تعليمي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الخبر، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف على كافة الأنشطة التعليمية والمساهمة في تطوير العملية التعليمية للجمعية. المهام الرئيسية يتولى مدير الإشراف التعليمي مسؤولية المشاركة في وضع الخطط والأهداف الرئيسية للعملية التعليمية ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى الإشراف على كافة النشاطات التعليمية في المنطقة أو القطاع المعني. كما يعمل على تقييم الاحتياجات المدرسية بالتنسيق مع الجهات المعنية ورفع التوصيات للإدارة العليا المتخصصة في الجمعية. المسؤوليات التفصيلية وضع معايير اختيار الأيتام المتفوقين، والتنسيق المسبق معهم في المرحلة الثانوية لرسم خارطة طريق تضمن حصولهم على المنحة الجامعية. التواصل مع الجامعات الأهلية، والتفاوض بشأن المقاعد والمنح والخصومات، ومتابعة إجراءات القبول والتسجيل، ومتابعة سداد الرسوم. إعداد ملفات فرص الدعم، وتقديم احتياجات المنح للمانحين، ومتابعة الالتزامات والاتفاقيات بالتنسيق مع إدارة الاستدامة المالية. متابعة المعدلات الدراسية للطلاب، ومعالجة التعثر الأكاديمي، والمحافظة على استمرارية المنح حتى التخرج. متابعة أعداد المقبولين والمستمرين والخريجين، ونسب النجاح، وتكاليف المنح، وإعداد تقارير دورية للمانحين. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة بالإشراف التعليمي أو إدارة المنح. القدرة على وضع الخطط والأهداف ومتابعة تنفيذها. مهارات تواصل وتفاوض ممتازة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير وتحليل البيانات. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

2577dff8d455c557.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ايديكس الدولية للمقاولات عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على الإشراف الهندسي وإعداد التصاميم والمخططات الإنشائية، بالإضافة إلى متابعة تنفيذ المشاريع لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال الهندسي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع لتحديد الاحتياجات الهندسية. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد التصاميم الإنشائية ومتابعة إعداد المخططات وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات الفنية للمواد الإنشائية. الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ المشروع لضمان مطابقة المواصفات والمعايير الهندسية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة المدنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسبة تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة شهادة جامعية في الهندسة المدنية. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية والمقاولات. معرفة قوية بأسس التصميم الإنشائي وتحليل التربة. القدرة على قراءة وتدقيق المخططات الهندسية وجداول الكميات. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في الإشراف على المشاريع وإدارة المواقع. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. مهارات تواصل فعالة والقدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. الالتزام بالمعايير الهندسية والجودة. تفاصيل الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المدنيين المؤهلين والذين تتوافق خبراتهم مع متطلبات هذا الدور للتقديم.

25cb4bd3bf4afec6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صدارا للتشغيل والصيانة عن مراقب كاميرات أمنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على الإشراف على عمليات كاميرات المراقبة الأمنية، وتشغيل أنظمة المراقبة، والاستجابة لحالات الطوارئ الأمنية على مدار الساعة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على عمليات كاميرات المراقبة الأمنية والتعامل مع حالات الإنذار وطوارئ الحرائق والتحقيق فيها، مع ضمان الاستجابة الفورية على مدار الساعة. تشغيل أنظمة الإنذار وكاميرات المراقبة ومراقبتها وصيانتها بشكل فعال. تنزيل التسجيلات وإدارتها لاستخدامها في التحقيقات المستقبلية، مع ضمان الامتثال لقواعد ولوائح خصوصية البيانات. التحقيق في الحالات الطارئة وانتهاكات السياسات والإجراءات الأمنية المعتمدة. اتباع السياسات والإجراءات التي تتوافق مع القوانين واللوائح الأمنية، وإبلاغ الإدارة بالمشكلات عند حدوثها. رفع التقارير المتعلقة بالأسباب والنتائج للإدارة، وتقديم التوصيات بمسار العمل المناسب. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على العمل بفعالية في بيئة تتطلب اليقظة والاستجابة السريعة. متطلبات العمل القدرة على تشغيل أنظمة المراقبة الأمنية والتعامل معها. فهم جيد لسياسات وإجراءات الأمن والسلامة. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير وتوثيق الأحداث. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، وتتطلب الالتزام بضمان الأمن والاستجابة للطوارئ على مدار الساعة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

25ee57b447dc4111.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ينابيع للمقاولات عن فني ميكانيكي تمديدات صحية وتدفئة وغاز للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد قوائم المواد والمعدات اللازمة لأعمال التمديدات، ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص أعطال المعدات الميكانيكية والإشراف على إصلاحها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى الفني الميكانيكي تمديدات صحية وتدفئة وغاز مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية، وتشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: إعداد قوائم مفصلة ببنود القطع والمواد والمعدات الضرورية لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الصحية والتدفئة المركزية وشبكات الغاز. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال شبكات أنابيب التمديدات الصحية والتدفئة المركزية وشبكات الغاز لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات والمعايير. تشخيص أعطال المعدات الميكانيكية بدقة ومتابعة عمليات إصلاحها لضمان استمرارية عملها. متابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للمعدات لتقليل الأعطال وضمان عمرها الافتراضي. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة في جميع مراحل العمل. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة لشغل هذا الدور، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال تمديدات الصحية والتدفئة والغاز. معرفة قوية بأنظمة التمديدات الميكانيكية وشبكات الغاز. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الميكانيكية وإيجاد الحلول المناسبة. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة المهنية. بيئة العمل يعمل الفني الميكانيكي ضمن فريق شركة ينابيع للمقاولات في مدينة الرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في مواقع العمل المختلفة حسب طبيعة المشاريع. نوع التوظيف هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

2571eae46818008b.description: About Lenovo Lenovo is a global technology company with US$83 billion in revenue, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500. Serving millions of customers across 180 markets, Lenovo focuses on delivering Smarter Technology for All. The company has expanded beyond its position as the world's largest PC provider to offer a comprehensive portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices, infrastructure, software, solutions, and services. Lenovo's ongoing investment in innovation aims to build a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future globally. The Role: Jr. Purchasing Specialist/Site Buyer Lenovo is seeking a Jr. Purchasing Specialist/Site Buyer to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is open to Saudi Nationals with 0-1 years of experience. The role involves managing purchase orders, coordinating with suppliers, and resolving various procurement-related issues to ensure smooth purchasing operations. Key Responsibilities Manage purchase orders, including placement and coordination with suppliers to resolve order and payment issues. Provide daily updates on BSR commitments. Oversee shipment follow-up and tracking, collaborating with logistics and import/export teams from suppliers. Work with cross-functional teams and suppliers to address shipment and material issues, such as receiving discrepancies, quantity mismatches, quality concerns, and RMA cases. Collaborate closely with GSM GCM to resolve material allocation, supply, and pricing challenges. Support accounting and suppliers in resolving invoice and payment-related issues. Maintain effective communication with suppliers and internal teams to ensure timely issue resolution and efficient purchasing operations. Required Qualifications and Skills 1-2 years of experience in a relevant field. Detail-oriented, self-motivated, and responsible, with a strong sense of ownership. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Good communication and coordination skills, with the ability to manage supplier relationships effectively. A strong team player with a proactive attitude and willingness to learn. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications. Good written and spoken English language skills. Benefits and Development Opportunities Lenovo offers a supportive work environment with a focus on employee well-being and professional growth. Benefits include an international team with a strong emphasis on gender diversity, access to an Employee Assistance Program for psychological, legal, and financial consultancy, and participation in a company that prioritizes sustainable solutions such as CO2 Offset, Asset Recovery Services, and the Lenovo Certified Refurbished portfolio. Employees also have access to an internal e-learning development platform for personal development and a mentorship program. Application Information This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Qualified Saudi Nationals are encouraged to apply.

25a7ae4e2be28689.description: تبحث شركتنا عن فني تصنيع ماهر للانضمام إلى فريقنا، حيث تتضمن مهام الوظيفة الإشراف على عمليات الإنتاج وضمان جودة المنتج النهائي. سيتمتع المرشح الناجح بفرصة العمل في بيئة ديناميكية والمساهمة في تطوير منتجات مبتكرة. نلتزم بتوفير بيئة عمل داعمة وفرص للنمو المهني. مهام ومسؤوليات فني التصنيع: * تشغيل وصيانة المعدات والآلات المستخدمة في خطوط الإنتاج. * مراقبة جودة المواد الخام والمنتجات النهائية والتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات. * تنفيذ إجراءات السلامة المهنية والالتزام بمعايير الصحة العامة في مكان العمل. * التعاون مع فريق الإنتاج لحل أي مشكلات فنية قد تطرأ أثناء سير العمل. * المشاركة في عمليات التجميع والتركيب للمكونات المختلفة للمنتجات.

25119149ed96b780.description: About Al-Watania Poultry Al-Watania Poultry, a leading company in Saudi Arabia, is seeking an Electrician Technician to join its team in Al Qassim. This full-time role is essential for maintaining the operational efficiency of production machinery and lines. This involves addressing daily electrical faults, executing scheduled maintenance programs, and ensuring the readiness and uninterrupted operation of equipment. The role requires a proactive approach to prevent issues and maintain high operational standards. Monitor and track the performance of production lines and all machinery. Prepare and submit reports to the department supervisor regarding maintenance activities and equipment status. 25853fec58251f84.description: Join Qiddiya Investment Company as a Senior Stakeholder Manager for our Roads Program, where transformation meets innovation in one of the largest entertainment destinations in the world. We are on a journey to create iconic experiences, and we need a seasoned professional who can navigate stakeholder relations with finesse and strategic insight. As the Senior Stakeholder Manager, you will oversee stakeholder engagement for the Roads Program, ensuring that all efforts align with our vision and operational goals. This role requires a deep understanding of infrastructure projects, strong communication abilities, and the capacity to build and maintain relationships across various stakeholders. Key Responsibilities: Stakeholder Engagement: Develop and implement comprehensive engagement strategies tailored to various stakeholders, including government entities, local communities, and project partners involved in the Roads Program. Communication Leadership: Lead the creation of communication materials, including reports and presentations, that articulate the program's progress, impacts, and value to stakeholders. Conflict Management: Identify and mitigate potential conflicts through proactive communication and negotiation techniques, ensuring stakeholder concerns are addressed promptly and effectively. Monitoring and Reporting: Track stakeholder engagement activities, measure satisfaction, and report outcomes to senior management, providing insights that guide decision-making. Collaborative Planning: Work closely with multidisciplinary teams to ensure that stakeholder feedback is integrated into the project planning and execution phases. Training and Development: Provide mentorship and training to junior team members, fostering a culture of stakeholder engagement excellence within the Roads Program. Market Analysis: Continuously monitor industry trends, regulatory environments, and stakeholder sentiments to inform engagement strategies and align with best practices. Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Urban Development, Communications, or a related field; a Master’s degree is a plus. A minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in stakeholder management, with a focus on large-scale infrastructure or road development projects. Demonstrated expertise in building and managing relationships with diverse stakeholder groups, including government and local communities. Proficient communication and negotiation skills, with a strong ability to convey complex information clearly. Proven analytical abilities to assess stakeholder needs and feedback effectively. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously. Fluency in English is required; proficiency in Arabic is highly desirable. Experience with project management tools and stakeholder engagement platforms. Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams. Join Qiddiya's team and enjoy a dynamic work environment that offers growth opportunities, a collaborative culture, and the chance to make a significant impact as our future Playmaker !

25a3d081fc4e668e.description: Role Summary The MEP Manager will lead and manage all Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) activities for the Project, ensuring design compliance, construction quality, safety, and timely delivery. This role requires strong leadership, technical expertise, and coordination skills to oversee contractors, consultants, and stakeholders, ensuring all MEP systems meet project specifications, local regulations, and international best practices. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage all MEP design review, construction, testing, and commissioning activities for the project. Coordinate with architects, structural engineers, contractors, and authorities to ensure seamless integration of MEP systems. Review and approve MEP drawings, material submittals, method statements, and technical proposals. Ensure compliance with Saudi codes, standards, project specifications, and international best practices. Monitor project schedules, budgets, and quality benchmarks related to MEP works. Identify risks, technical issues, and design conflicts, and implement effective mitigation strategies. Supervise contractors and site teams to ensure safe execution and high-quality workmanship. Oversee testing, commissioning, and handover of MEP systems to ensure operational readiness. Prepare regular progress reports and provide technical input to senior management and clients. Qualifications & Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering . Relevant professional membership (preferred). Minimum 15+ years of experience in MEP works for high-rise tower projects . Mandatory experience in Saudi Arabia (KSA) . PMC (Project Management Consultancy) experience is highly preferred . Strong knowledge of MEP systems, codes, standards, and commissioning processes. Proven leadership, coordination, and stakeholder management skills. Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities.

2543e591a4db0309.description: About the Role Saudi Bauer Foundations Company is seeking an Electrical Technician to join their team in Jeddah. This full-time role is designed for professionals with 3-5 years of experience in industrial electrical maintenance and troubleshooting. The Electrical Technician will be responsible for maintaining, repairing, and improving electrical systems, machinery, and equipment to ensure efficient and reliable operations. Role Overview The Electrical Technician will play a key role in minimizing equipment downtime, enhancing machine performance, and ensuring adherence to BAUER's quality, environmental, and health and safety standards. The position requires hands-on experience in electrical maintenance, fault diagnosis, electrical panel repairs, and maintenance planning. Key Responsibilities Analyze, diagnose, and rectify electrical faults in machinery and industrial equipment. Perform regular inspections, preventive maintenance, and corrective maintenance activities. Maintain equipment history files and ensure proper documentation of all electrical maintenance activities. Maintain cleanliness and housekeeping standards within the electrical maintenance unit. Identify and recommend opportunities to improve machine efficiency through component replacement, upgrades, or complete equipment replacement. Develop and implement periodic electrical maintenance and servicing plans. Conduct site visits when necessary to perform emergency electrical repairs and troubleshooting. Repair and maintain electrical panel boards and control systems. Perform general electrical wiring and installation works when required. Identify, order, and manage spare parts and electrical components. Maintain accurate records of spare parts consumption, deliveries, and received materials. Provide technical guidance and training to new employees on electrical maintenance procedures and safety practices. Qualifications and Experience Diploma in Electrical or an equivalent qualification. 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in a similar role within the same industry. Strong knowledge of industrial electrical systems, machinery, and equipment. Proven experience in electrical troubleshooting, maintenance, and repair. Good understanding of preventive and corrective maintenance procedures. Required Skills Ability to work independently and manage electrical maintenance activities effectively. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Good communication and teamwork skills. Basic command of English, both written and spoken. Strong commitment to workplace safety, quality, and environmental standards. Application Process The salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

Standardize Agile workflows, templates, and reporting practices where required. Lead retrospectives and track continuous improvement initiatives. Facilitate communication between business and technology teams. Support dependency management and alignment across Agile teams and workstreams. Sciences & Systems or Any relevant field Work Experience 6 to 10 Years Technical / Functional Competencies Applications System Analysis Applications System Design Profile description: Alfanar is a Saudi company with an international presence, primarily engaged in the manufacturing and trading of a wide variety of low, medium, and high voltage electrical products, in addition to its portfolio of conventional and renewable energy solutions, oil and gas, water treatment, infrastructure, technical services, and digital solutions. With this in mind, alfanar promotes a proactive work environment where its employees are always valued, nurtured, and empowered to fuel their pride in being part of alfanar. For more information about alfanar, please visit alfanar.com

25fa7b22d1b2d1d7.description: Your Practice. Your Patients. Your Terms. | Psychiatrist, MEDirect Mental health care works best when patients feel safe, and many feel safest at home. MEDirect lets licensed psychiatrists launch their own fully branded virtual clinic, under their own name, without the months of setup. No premises, no staff, no IT to manage. You focus on your patients. We handle the infrastructure. What you’ll have from day one: Your own branded clinic: your name, your logo, your profile and your own booking page. Private, secure video sessions: discreet care your patients can join from anywhere. Full control: you set your hours, your session types and your fees. Patient records and follow-ups: notes, history and ongoing care in one place. E-prescriptions with medicine delivery: prescribe, and your patient’s medicine arrives at their door. Lab orders: for monitoring when treatment requires it. A dedicated onboarding team: we set you up and stay with you as you grow. Why psychiatrists join: You build a practice you own, with patients who stay with you over time. You reach patients who would never walk into a clinic. You decide how much or how little you work. Who we’re looking for: An active SCFHS licence in psychiatry. Experience with ongoing patient care and follow-up. Comfortable with video sessions and digital tools. Ready to practise independently alongside your current role, where your contract allows, or as your main practice. Ready to launch? Message us with your licence status, and we’ll show you your clinic.

252f42669b55d2b2.description: Family offices sit at the heart of our investor network, and we're hiring the person who will lead the team that looks after them. Pairs is a vetted private capital network. We put break-out founders in front of the family offices, VCs and strategic investors who fit them, and our team runs the investor relations work around every introduction. We are paid by the founder for our work, never by the round. Investors are members of the network and pay nothing. We also invest our own money alongside our members, most recently into a Series A next to a family office from our network. Why family offices More and more family offices want to invest directly in the best private companies, without a fund in between. 25603c37db8e22c8.description: Job description About Soum Soum is a fast-growing B2C marketplace based in Riyadh, connecting buyers and sellers of used electronics and used cars across Saudi Arabia through our website and mobile app. Everything we do is built on trust: buyers need confidence in what they are getting, and sellers need confidence they will be paid fairly and quickly. With the recent launch of our subscription model for electronics and cars, Soum is building the go-to recommerce platform in the Kingdom. About the Role The Consumer Product Manager owns the experience our customers touch every day: how buyers discover, evaluate, pay for and receive a used phone or car, and how sellers list, price and get paid for what they sell. You will be the voice of the Soum customer inside the product team, turning deep consumer insight into features that grow conversion, repeat purchase and trust in the platform. You will work across the app and web, partnering with design, engineering, operations and commercial teams to ship quickly and learn from what we ship. Key Responsibilities Own the roadmap for a core consumer area (such as the buyer journey, the seller journey or subscriptions), prioritising ruthlessly by impact on conversion, retention, GMV and customer trust. Build a deep, continuous understanding of Soum's customers through user interviews, usability testing, app reviews, customer support tickets and behavioural data. Optimise the end-to-end marketplace funnel: listing creation, search and discovery, product pages, checkout and payments (Mada, Apple Pay, BNPL), delivery tracking, returns and post-purchase experience. Design and improve trust features that make buying used feel safe, including device condition grading, car inspection reports, verified sellers, buyer protection, ratings and transparent pricing. Shape the subscription products for electronics and cars: the value proposition, packaging, onboarding, engagement and retention, working closely with Commercial and Finance on unit economics. Run a disciplined experimentation practice: form hypotheses, design A/B tests, define success metrics and make fast, evidence-based decisions on what to scale or kill. Monitor and report on core consumer KPIs, including conversion rate, listing-to-sale rate, activation, repeat purchase, subscription retention, NPS and customer complaints. Partner cross-functionally with Operations (inspection, logistics, customer service), Marketing and Growth (acquisition, CRM), and Finance to make sure product changes work end to end, not just on screen.
